entries.title: Philemon 1:1
segments: To my beloved friend and coworker Philemon,

entries.title: Philemon 1:2
segments: to my sister Apphia, to my fellow soldier Archippus, and to the church which meets at Philemon's house: From Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and brother Timothy:

entries.title: Philemon 1:3
segments: Grace and peace be to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:4
segments: I am ever mentioning you in my prayers, and giving thanks to God,

entries.title: Philemon 1:5
segments: because I am hearing of your love and of the faith which you hold, not only toward the Lord Jesus Christ, but toward all the saints.

entries.title: Philemon 1:6
segments: And I pray that your participation may become effectual, as you come to acknowledge every good thing which is in you to Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:7
segments: For I have great joy and comfort in your love, my brother, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed.

entries.title: Philemon 1:8
segments: And so, although I might be bold in Christ to dictate to you what is fitting,

entries.title: Philemon 1:9
segments: yet for love's sake, I rather beseech you, I, Paul, an old man, and now a prisoner for Christ Jesus!

entries.title: Philemon 1:10
segments: I beseech you for my son, Onesimus, whom I have begotten in these chains.

entries.title: Philemon 1:11
segments: Once you found him "unprofitable," but now he is "profitable" to you and to me.

entries.title: Philemon 1:12
segments: I am sending him back to you, he himself, that is, my very heart!

entries.title: Philemon 1:13
segments: I could wish to retain him at my side, so that he might minister to me in your stead, in my bonds for the gospel.

entries.title: Philemon 1:14
segments: But without your consent I was unwilling to do anything, so that your kindness to me might be of your own free will, and not of compulsion.

entries.title: Philemon 1:15
segments: Perhaps for this reason you were separated from him for an hour, in order that you might have him back forever,

entries.title: Philemon 1:16
segments: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, as a brother beloved; especially dear to me, but how much more to you, both as a man and a fellow Christian.

entries.title: Philemon 1:17
segments: If then you count me as a partner, receive him as you would me.

entries.title: Philemon 1:18
segments: And if he has wronged you at all, or is owing you anything, charge that to me.

entries.title: Philemon 1:19
segments: I Paul am writing this in my own handwriting, "I will repay you." But I will not mention that you owe me, over and over, your very soul.

entries.title: Philemon 1:20
segments: Come my brother, let me have joy in the Lord because of you! Refresh my heart in Christ!

entries.title: Philemon 1:21
segments: Because I am thoroughly persuaded of your obedience, I have written you, knowing full well that you will do by me what I am asking.

entries.title: Philemon 1:22
segments: Please also prepare for me a lodging, for I am hoping by your prayers to be restored to you again.

entries.title: Philemon 1:23
segments: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greeting;

entries.title: Philemon 1:24
segments: so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

entries.title: Philemon 1:25
segments: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
